metadata.title: DeepSeek Harness Executable Formalization Blueprint
metadata.adr_candidate_validation: ADR-07 through ADR-10 focused spikes exit 0 with zero warnings under pinned Lean 4.33.0 / Mathlib v4.33.0 on 2026-08-28; compiler validation is interface evidence only
metadata.revision_note: Reconciles repaired ADR-07..10 compiler evidence and packet completeness while preserving acceptance-gated post-kernel integration waves.
metadata.purpose: Turn accepted ADR contracts into a standalone Lean metatheory kernel and a finite executable vertical slice.
metadata.scope: Relation, reversible effects, partial operations, ranked iterators, abstract state/registry, alpha transport, a two-counter example, and acceptance-gated post-kernel planning.
non_goals: End-to-end verification of the TypeScript Cordis runtime
A complete Section 4 lifecycle/control proof in the first pass
Reopening ADR-01 through ADR-06 or mutating H03/H04 baselines
Treating proposed or incomplete ADR-07 through ADR-10 artifacts as accepted production inputs

decision_profile.G2: A start: standalone package, with a reserved STC.Adapter seam
decision_profile.G3: C: two disjoint counters, failure, ranked iterator, and alpha transport
decision_profile.G4: C: staged hybrid; shallow executable effects now, deep DSL/interpreter seam reserved
decision_profile.G5: C: RegistryLike abstraction, Toy List+Nodup registry, later Finmap adapter
decision_profile.G6: B: general failure retains error, boundary, and successful-prefix undo; atomicity is Toy-only
decision_profile.state_carrier: abstract StateLike first, then ADR-03 RawState/ValidState adapter
decision_profile.working_validation_profile: A+I+K+E, with R0 adapter seam only
fixed_architecture: raw exact computation plus explicit relation-parametric law architecture
no global Setoid and no quotient execution carrier
positive finite ADR-03 state shell; no State -> State closure in FiberCell
lifetime-safe IncarnationId and explicit alpha action
ranked continuation machine with explicit failure result
ADR-06 equivalence, relator, iterator-transport, and alpha-transport contracts

tasks.title: Pin source and toolchain
tasks.objective: Find an existing host checkout and its Lean/Lake pin; otherwise initialize the standalone package.
acceptance_criteria: no assumption that spike pin equals production pin
risks: no checkout or incompatible Lean version
tasks.rollback_rule: retain standalone plan and record incompatibility; do not alter frozen artifacts

tasks.title: Freeze baselines and create Definition Ledger
tasks.objective: Record H03/H04 and ADR hashes, then map all 74 numbered and 8 auxiliary items to future modules and statuses.
acceptance_criteria: every item has one traceability row
risks: confusing baseline readiness with current readiness
tasks.rollback_rule: regenerate derived report from frozen inputs

tasks.title: Canonical relation vocabulary
tasks.objective: Define relation-parametric laws and distinguish same-input PointwiseRel from CrossRel.
risks: silently reusing the old cross-input PointwiseRel name
tasks.rollback_rule: retain ADR-06 naming and revise only production declarations

tasks.title: Result and observation relators
tasks.objective: Relate Option, success results, failure results, and observation pullbacks without erasing tags.
risks: overly coarse observation relation
tasks.rollback_rule: split relation profiles instead of weakening the core relation

tasks.title: Relation congruence kernel
tasks.objective: Prove basic closure and specialization results while keeping raw computations exact.
risks: mistaking directional simulation for equivalence
tasks.rollback_rule: state converse as a separate theorem

tasks.title: Shallow Effect and undo algebra
tasks.objective: Define success-only EffectResult, external undo functions, identity, and LIFO sequence.
risks: reversing accumulator order
tasks.rollback_rule: keep composeUndo convention explicit in tests

tasks.title: Lawful witnessed effects
tasks.objective: State selected-inverse stability, relation-respecting undo, and local recovery as explicit laws.
risks: proving only endpoint equality and forgetting inverse selection
tasks.rollback_rule: add a named stability field rather than weakening recovery

tasks.title: Sequential closure and LIFO recovery
tasks.objective: Prove composition preserves lawfulness and applies the most recent inverse first.
acceptance_criteria: substantive K proof and executable instance
risks: hidden dependence on independence for ordinary LIFO
tasks.rollback_rule: separate LIFO theorem from selective-removal theorem

tasks.title: Hybrid DSL boundary
tasks.objective: Reserve deep EffectCode/interpreter/refinement interfaces while keeping the first core shallow.
risks: introducing a full DSL too early
tasks.rollback_rule: keep the boundary signature and defer deep constructors

tasks.title: Partial operation outcomes
tasks.objective: Represent definedness, outcome tags, selected inverses, and undefined operations explicitly.
tests: one side defined/one side undefined negative case
acceptance_criteria: Option is used only for undefinedness, not iterator failure
risks: outcome erasure
tasks.rollback_rule: restore explicit sum/tag fields

tasks.title: Independence and stability contracts
tasks.objective: State and prove the finite two-counter independence laws, including inverse-selection stability.
acceptance_criteria: one positive law and one non-vacuous counterexample
risks: endpoint equality hiding tag or inverse mismatch
tasks.rollback_rule: strengthen operation relation before adding more theorems

tasks.title: Failure boundary and prefix undo
tasks.objective: Define failure with error, boundary state, and the inverse of the successful prefix.
acceptance_criteria: general failure does not assume atomicity
risks: accidentally returning no boundary information
tasks.rollback_rule: keep atomic failure only as an instance contract

tasks.title: Ranked continuation machine
tasks.objective: Define StageResult, external Q, rank, state-dependent successor, and strict decrease.
risks: confusing finite path bound with all-node enumeration
tasks.rollback_rule: keep explicit finite-support specialization separate

tasks.title: Well-founded execution and LIFO fold
tasks.objective: Define execFrom by rank and prove termination, success composition, and failure prefix preservation.
acceptance_criteria: prefix inverse is retained on raise
risks: termination proof hidden behind fuel
tasks.rollback_rule: fuel may be an implementation adapter, never the semantic invariant

tasks.title: Iterator relation and witness interfaces
tasks.objective: Add stage/iterator relation, simulation, bisimulation, and witness hooks without quotient execution.
acceptance_criteria: bisimulation not silently assumed from one-way simulation
risks: relation orientation errors
tasks.rollback_rule: name converse/simulation explicitly

tasks.title: StateLike and observation profiles
tasks.objective: Keep state carrier abstract and pass observation relations explicitly; do not install a hidden global relation.
tests: two observation profiles on one carrier
acceptance_criteria: no global Setoid and no hidden state relation
risks: homogeneous shell mistaken for dependent RawState
tasks.rollback_rule: keep RawState as a later adapter

tasks.title: RegistryLike and Toy registry
tasks.objective: Define lookup/insert/erase/domain laws and provide a finite List+Nodup fiber-registry instance.
risks: treating List+Nodup as ADR-02's store
tasks.rollback_rule: retain a separate Store/Finmap façade

tasks.title: ADR-03 state adapter seam
tasks.objective: Expose one-way interfaces for RawState, ValidState, WellFormed, provider provenance, and checked updates.
risks: Finmap details blocking the core
tasks.rollback_rule: leave adapter as a contract and continue Toy work

tasks.title: Alpha action and transport
tasks.objective: Define permutation actions and transport for name-neutral state, undo, stages, iterators, and execution.
risks: alpha action omits a reference field
tasks.rollback_rule: restrict first theorem to name-neutral profile

tasks.title: Two-counter effects
tasks.objective: Instantiate two disjoint counters with increments, decrements, and concrete inverse witnesses.
acceptance_criteria: at least one real K theorem and E test
risks: Toy theorem overclaimed as full Cordis theorem
tasks.rollback_rule: label theorem assumptions and refinement gap

tasks.title: Failure and ranked iterator slice
tasks.objective: Run a two-level iterator on success and failure paths, retaining the prefix inverse.
acceptance_criteria: failIfZero marked Toy atomic specialization only
risks: using fuel instead of rank semantics
tasks.rollback_rule: retain rank certificate as authoritative

tasks.title: Alpha-renamed slice
tasks.objective: Add named labels/IDs and show name-neutral execution transport under a finite permutation.
acceptance_criteria: labels are genuinely name-bearing in the Toy
risks: testing alpha on anonymous counters only
tasks.rollback_rule: keep name-neutral theorem separate from name-bearing extensions

tasks.title: Derived readiness manifest
tasks.objective: Publish current A/I/K/E/R0/R1+ evidence for every mapped paper item without changing H03/H04.
risks: calling architecture closure a full theorem closure
tasks.rollback_rule: regenerate from task evidence and frozen inputs

tasks.title: Cordis R0 seam
tasks.objective: Define one-way Concrete-to-Abstract abstraction and simulation types without claiming implementation verification.
risks: adapter names implying verified runtime
tasks.rollback_rule: keep adapter one-way and purely contractual

tasks.title: Definition Ledger
tasks.objective: Map paper definitions, theorems, lemmas, corollaries, and auxiliary rules to production modules and evidence states.
risks: confusing architecture closure with theorem proof
tasks.rollback_rule: regenerate from H03/H04 without editing them

tasks.title: Bootstrap hygiene
tasks.objective: Add a root import, strict placeholder scan, and explicit historical-spike exclusion rules.
acceptance_criteria: historical spikes are not production imports
risks: false positives from archival comments
tasks.rollback_rule: narrow scan paths explicitly and retain raw output

tasks.title: Atomic Toy failure specialization
tasks.objective: Use failIfZero as a prechecked no-change specialization while keeping the general boundary contract.
acceptance_criteria: not promoted to general ADR-05 law
risks: overgeneralizing atomicity
tasks.rollback_rule: remove specialization without changing ExecResult

tasks.title: Nested iterator failure transport
tasks.objective: Exercise nested ranked continuations and preserve prefix undo across a raise.
acceptance_criteria: rank, not arbitrary fuel, drives semantics
risks: losing outer undo on nested failure
tasks.rollback_rule: retain simple one-level test as fallback

tasks.title: Store/registry boundary
tasks.objective: Document that RegistryLike models the fiber registry while ADR-02's dependent coeffect store remains Finmap-authoritative.
acceptance_criteria: Toy registry is not advertised as coeffect store
risks: homogeneous Toy abstraction leaking into dependent model
tasks.rollback_rule: keep façade documentation-only until Finmap adapter

tasks.title: Freshness and trace boundary
tasks.objective: Keep ever-issued ledger and allocation metadata outside default CoreStateObs, with explicit name-aware boundary.
tests: ledger not erased for allocation test
risks: treating RawState alone as freshness Markov state
tasks.rollback_rule: use explicit product boundary for allocation

tasks.title: Defer name-bearing alpha payloads
tasks.objective: Record name-bearing Q, Xi, ambient, accumulator, and control payload transport as later work.
risks: scope creep into control
tasks.rollback_rule: keep as explicit deferred task

tasks.title: Integrated recovery theorem
tasks.objective: Combine effect recovery, independence, and iterator prefix recovery for the Toy trace.
risks: claiming full Section 4 theorem
tasks.rollback_rule: split into smaller lemmas if integration proof obscures assumptions

tasks.title: Alpha regression
tasks.objective: Run the same named two-counter trace after a nontrivial finite permutation.
risks: vacuous alpha test
tasks.rollback_rule: retain name-neutral effect tests separately

tasks.title: Vertical-slice report
tasks.objective: Summarize theorem, execution, alignment, and remaining refinement gaps for the first slice.
acceptance_criteria: K/E are not presented as R
risks: premature readiness inflation
tasks.rollback_rule: reissue derived report only

tasks.title: Feedback and rollback log
tasks.objective: Record failed proofs, counterexamples, toolchain deviations, and superseding-ADR triggers.
risks: silent semantic drift
tasks.rollback_rule: restore last task manifest and retain failed attempt

traceability_policy.coverage: All 74 numbered nodes and 8 auxiliary nodes must eventually have one derived row; first implementation waves may cover only the listed high-impact refs.
traceability_policy.paper_relation: Mark each item faithful, faithful-explicit, type-repair, logical-repair, computability-repair, decomposition, derived, generalization, specialization, replacement, or refinement-only.
traceability_policy.status_rule: File location is not ADR acceptance. Compiled interface is I, not architecture closure or K. A contract is not a proved theorem. Toy E evidence does not imply runtime R.
traceability_policy.cycle_rule: Preserve H03 forward-reference cycles (D49/R.iter/R.fail and D67/L68) as deferred or explicitly staged; do not force a false topological order.

deferred.reason: ADR-07 accepted and Control production merged; concrete guarded-rule theorems remain pending
ADR-08 accepted and derived Staging production merged; global adequacy remains pending
ADR-09 accepted and Support production/bridges merged; concrete lifecycle projection remains pending
ADR-10 accepted architecturally; Scoped production remains the independent P12 lane
concrete TypeScript/runtime refinement requires a source audit and simulation proof
EffectCode and interpreter semantics are reserved by G4 but not required for the first executable core

milestone_commands: example-by-decide or tooling-only finite property test
execution_protocol.decision_gate: No P10+ production module may be created until the corresponding candidate has a complete packet and explicit accepted ADR status. ADR-07..10 now have accepted status records; production and kernel evidence remain separate dimensions.
execution_protocol.migration: After explicit ADR acceptance, port declarations manually from the reviewed packet while keeping historical spikes read-only; never import duplicate namespaces or port a proposed/incomplete spike as normative code.
execution_protocol.feedback: A failed proof or counterexample may revise a provisional API task; a semantic change to an accepted ADR requires a superseding ADR. Proposed ADR promotion remains a lead-review gate even after compiler validation.
execution_protocol.trusted_boundary: Lean kernel, pinned libraries, explicitly recorded assumptions, and the selected abstract state/observation model.

integrity.accepted_adr_hash_note: P0-baseline.json provenance ruling remains authoritative for the known ADR-01, ADR-02, and ADR-06 spike manifest mismatches; this synchronization does not normalize them.
integrity.self_hash_policy: Compute the Markdown hash after final local bytes. JSON self-hash remains pending/excluded; do not embed a stale hash.
